notes: Chubby squirrel with short stubby arms (hands are small paws: hand + one 'hand1' finger-mitten bone). No neck bone (head sits on the torso). The source has one torso bone; it was split into torso (role spine) + torso_upper (role chest) with weights blended along the bone. femar_L/femar_R are pelvis-side hip bones between the hips and the thighs. The eyes were separate rigid meshes and are now skinned 100% to the head. Ears are small fur tufts without bones (not prominent enough for a spring chain). Facing +Z (glTF/Godot), +Y up, metres; soles at y=0, centred between the feet. Top of skull at y=0.900 (ears/hats excluded), crown point (x 0.077, y 0.900, z -0.038); head width 0.400 m, depth 0.496 m; head bone origin at (x 0.001, y 0.538, z -0.084). Rest pose T (upper arm 10 deg below horizontal). 23 bones, 6348 triangles. Bone local axes follow Blender's convention (+Y along each bone towards its child).
